answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The pearl holds work receipts rather than names, so the relic of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, converted to a slow vesting stream, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. The forge of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
